name: mtools
description: Collection of utilities to access MS-DOS/FAT disk images without mounting them, used by bootloaders such as Limine to build UEFI CD/FAT images.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
